start: Signed in to HQ less than 15 minutes ago; details not set yet

steps.action: Open 'Payments' and scroll to 'Your payment details'
user_sees: The card open with 'Not set yet'
'Not set: gym owners see “Payment is not available yet” and no QR code. Fill these in to start taking payments.'
must_not: The card folded with nothing set

steps.action: Fill 'UPI ID', 'Name on UPI', 'Account name', 'Account number', 'IFSC', 'Bank (optional)' and tap 'Save payment details'
user_sees: Question 'Change where gym owners send money?'
'Saved. Gym owners see the new details the next time they open Pay MettleUp.'
must_not: The values written into the HQ Log

start: Signed in to HQ more than 15 minutes ago

steps.action: Change the UPI ID and tap 'Save payment details', answer yes
user_sees: 'For this, sign in again first (it must be within the last 15 minutes).'
must_not: The typed values lost before signing in again

user_sees: 'Payments need the database update 0060 (waiting for your yes).'
Folded card 'Your payment details' with 'What gym owners pay to: UPI <id>'

steps.action: Open it, change the IFSC, save, answer yes
user_sees: After reload a new Last changed date
must_not: The old IFSC shown after the reload

user_sees: 'Kept only in the gym server, never in the code. Any signed-in gym owner can read them, so a UPI ID without your mobile number is safer.'
must_not: The account number written into the public code or the Log

start: Owner signed in online; MettleUp details set

steps.action: Open Settings, then Pay MettleUp, pick a plan
user_sees: QR code 'UPI QR code to pay ₹<x> to MettleUp'
must_not: A QR code without the amount

start: Trial banner in the last 14 days

user_sees: The same details and QR code
must_not: A different UPI ID than on Settings

start: MettleUp has not set its details; then a front-desk login

must_not: A QR code with an empty UPI ID

user_sees: 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp'
must_not: The bank details shown to the desk

start: Owner has Pay MettleUp open; HQ changes the UPI ID

user_sees: The old UPI ID still shown
must_not: A payment to an ID MettleUp no longer uses with no hint

user_sees: The new UPI ID and a new QR code
must_not: The old ID still shown after reopening
